issue.title: Do not keep network failures as sync errors on the Sync page [Returning online and sync changes Audit]
issue.body:
Found during the returning online and synchronizing changes audit (#530, epic #526).

**Severity:** Low  
**Launch blocker:** No  
**Confirmed on:** Xiaomi Redmi Note 9 Pro, Android 10 (API 29), local debug build of `09ff2fd` (PR #559 head), `dev.api.fluent.bible` (scenario C.11 and the H.24 attempt)

## Summary

Network failures during a metadata sync are stored as sync errors and stay on the Sync page after the connection is back and uploads succeed, and also while offline.

A metadata step that fails on a flapping connection stores the DNS error as `sync_error_*` (`src/services/sync.ts:121-168`). Keys clear when that step next succeeds, but master data, pericope sets and Bible texts run only in the full sync. `useSync` recomputes the text only when `isSyncing` changes and skips its refresh while in the error state (`src/hooks/useSync.ts:36-58`, `:91-100`).

## Expected

No sync error once the connection is back and sync succeeds; being offline is shown as offline, not as a failure.

## Actual

"Sync failed: master data" (and "pericope sets" / "bible texts") stays next to "Online · all synced", also offline, until sign-out and sign-in. The 2026-09-28 log shows `Sync error stored` for `sync_error_chapter_assignments` with a DNS failure.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Tap Sync Now while the connection is unstable (or turn Wi-Fi off right after tapping it).
2. Reconnect and let uploads finish.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Transport failures (offline, DNS, timeout) do not set persistent sync step errors, or are cleared on the next successful sync.
- [ ] The Sync page error text updates when the stored errors change.
- [ ] Unit tests for both.
- [ ] Android device QA (C.11).

## Related

- Parent audit: #530 (epic #526)
- #470, #18, #292
- Assessment: `docs/assessments/returning-online-and-sync/README.md` (PR #598)
